paragraphs.text: translated by
1. MAY they who would assume kinship from far away, Vivasvan's generations, dearly loved of men,
paragraphs.original: परावतो ये दिधिषन्त आप्यं मनुप्रीतासो जनिमा विवस्वतः ।
paragraphs.translit: parāvato ye didhiṣanta āpyaṃ manuprītāso janimā vivasvataḥ |

paragraphs.text: Even the Gods who sit upon the sacred grass of Nahusa's son Yayati, bless and comfort us.
paragraphs.original: ययातेर्ये नहुष्यस्य बर्हिषि देवा आसते ते अधि ब्रुवन्तु नः
paragraphs.translit: yayāterye nahuṣyasya barhiṣi devā āsate te adhi bruvantu naḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. For worthy of obeisance, Gods, are all your names, worthy of adoration and of sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: विश्वा हि वो नमस्यानि वन्द्या नामानि देवा उत यज्ञियानि वः ।
paragraphs.translit: viśvā hi vo namasyāni vandyā nāmāni devā uta yajñiyāni vaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Ye who were born from waters, and from Aditi, and from the earth, do ye here listen to my call.
paragraphs.original: ये स्थ जाता अदितेरद्भ्यस्परि ये पृथिव्यास्ते म इह श्रुता हवम्
paragraphs.translit: ye stha jātā aditeradbhyaspari ye pṛthivyāste ma iha śrutā havam

paragraphs.text: 3. I will rejoice in these Adityas for my weal, for whom the Mother pours forth water rich in balm,
paragraphs.original: येभ्यो माता मधुमत्पिन्वते पयः पीयूषं द्यौरदितिरद्रिबर्हाः ।
paragraphs.translit: yebhyo mātā madhumatpinvate payaḥ pīyūṣaṃ dyauraditiradribarhāḥ |

paragraphs.text: And Dyaus the Infinite, firm as a rock, sweet milk,-Gods active, strong through lauds, whose might the Bull upholds.
paragraphs.original: उक्थशुष्मान्वृषभरान्स्वप्नसस्ताँ आदित्याँ अनु मदा स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: ukthaśuṣmānvṛṣabharānsvapnasastām̐ ādityām̐ anu madā svastaye

paragraphs.text: 4. Looking on men, ne'er slumbering, they by their deserts attained as Gods to lofty immortality.
paragraphs.original: नृचक्षसो अनिमिषन्तो अर्हणा बृहद्देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः ।
paragraphs.translit: nṛcakṣaso animiṣanto arhaṇā bṛhaddevāso amṛtatvamānaśuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Borne on refulgent cars, sinless, with serpents' powers, they robe them, for our welfare, in the height of heaven.
paragraphs.original: ज्योतीरथा अहिमाया अनागसो दिवो वर्ष्माणं वसते स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: jyotīrathā ahimāyā anāgaso divo varṣmāṇaṃ vasate svastaye

paragraphs.text: 5. Great Kings who bless us, who have come to sacrifice, who, ne'er assailed, have set their mansion in the sky,
paragraphs.original: सम्राजो ये सुवृधो यज्ञमाययुरपरिह्वृता दधिरे दिवि क्षयम् ।
paragraphs.translit: samrājo ye suvṛdho yajñamāyayuraparihvṛtā dadhire divi kṣayam |

paragraphs.text: These I invite with adoration and with hymns, mighty Adityas, Aditi, for happiness.
paragraphs.original: ताँ आ विवास नमसा सुवृक्तिभिर्महो आदित्याँ अदितिं स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: tām̐ ā vivāsa namasā suvṛktibhirmaho ādityām̐ aditiṃ svastaye

paragraphs.text: 6. Who offereth to you the laud that ye accept, O ye All-Gods of Manu, many as ye are?
paragraphs.original: को व स्तोमं राधति यं जुजोषथ विश्वे देवासो मनुषो यति ष्ठन ।
paragraphs.translit: ko va stomaṃ rādhati yaṃ jujoṣatha viśve devāso manuṣo yati ṣṭhana |

paragraphs.text: Who, Mighty Ones, will prepare for you the sacrifice to bear us over trouble to felicity?
paragraphs.original: को वोऽध्वरं तुविजाता अरं करद्यो नः पर्षदत्यंहः स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: ko vo'dhvaraṃ tuvijātā araṃ karadyo naḥ parṣadatyaṃhaḥ svastaye

paragraphs.text: 7. Ye to whom Manu, by seven priests, with kindled fire, offered the first oblation with his heart and soul,
paragraphs.original: येभ्यो होत्रां प्रथमामायेजे मनुः समिद्धाग्निर्मनसा सप्त होतृभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: yebhyo hotrāṃ prathamāmāyeje manuḥ samiddhāgnirmanasā sapta hotṛbhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Vouchsafe us, ye Adityas, sheitcr free from fear, and make us good and easy paths to happiness.
paragraphs.original: त आदित्या अभयं शर्म यच्छत सुगा नः कर्त सुपथा स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: ta ādityā abhayaṃ śarma yacchata sugā naḥ karta supathā svastaye

paragraphs.text: 8. Wise Deities, who have dominion o'er the world, ye thinkers over all that moves not and that moves,
paragraphs.original: य ईशिरे भुवनस्य प्रचेतसो विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च मन्तवः ।
paragraphs.translit: ya īśire bhuvanasya pracetaso viśvasya sthāturjagataśca mantavaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Save us from uncommitted and committed sin, preserve us from all sin to-day for happiness.
paragraphs.original: ते नः कृतादकृतादेनसस्पर्यद्या देवासः पिपृता स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: te naḥ kṛtādakṛtādenasasparyadyā devāsaḥ pipṛtā svastaye

paragraphs.text: 9. In battles we invoke Indra still swift to hear, and all the holy Host of Heaven who banish grief,
paragraphs.original: भरेष्विन्द्रं सुहवं हवामहेऽंहोमुचं सुकृतं दैव्यं जनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: bhareṣvindraṃ suhavaṃ havāmahe'ṃhomucaṃ sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ janam |

paragraphs.text: Agni, Mitra, and Varuna that we may gain, Dyays, Bhaga, Maruts, Prthivi for happiness:
paragraphs.original: अग्निं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं द्यावापृथिवी मरुतः स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: agniṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī marutaḥ svastaye

paragraphs.text: 10. Mightily-saving Earth, incomparable Heaven the good guide Aditi who gives secure defense
paragraphs.original: सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyāmanehasaṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim |

paragraphs.text: The well-oared heavenly Ship that lets no waters in, free from defect, will we ascend for happiness.
paragraphs.original: दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसमस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrāmanāgasamasravantīmā ruhemā svastaye

paragraphs.text: 11. Bless us, all Holy Ones, that we may have your help, guard and protect us from malignant injury.
paragraphs.original: विश्वे यजत्रा अधि वोचतोतये त्रायध्वं नो दुरेवाया अभिह्रुतः ।
paragraphs.translit: viśve yajatrā adhi vocatotaye trāyadhvaṃ no durevāyā abhihrutaḥ |

paragraphs.text: With fruitful invocation may we call on you, Gods, who give ear to us for grace, for happiness.
paragraphs.original: सत्यया वो देवहूत्या हुवेम शृण्वतो देवा अवसे स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: satyayā vo devahūtyā huvema śṛṇvato devā avase svastaye

paragraphs.text: 12. Keep all disease afar and sordid sacrifice, keep off the wicked man's malicious enmity.
paragraphs.original: अपामीवामप विश्वामनाहुतिमपारातिं दुर्विदत्रामघायतः ।
paragraphs.translit: apāmīvāmapa viśvāmanāhutimapārātiṃ durvidatrāmaghāyataḥ |

paragraphs.text: Keep far away from us all hatred, O ye Gods, and give us ample shelter for our happiness.
paragraphs.original: आरे देवा द्वेषो अस्मद्युयोतनोरु णः शर्म यच्छता स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: āre devā dveṣo asmadyuyotanoru ṇaḥ śarma yacchatā svastaye

paragraphs.text: 13. Untouched by any evil, every mortal thrives, and, following the Law, spreads in his progeny.
paragraphs.original: अरिष्टः स मर्तो विश्व एधते प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्परि ।
paragraphs.translit: ariṣṭaḥ sa marto viśva edhate pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇaspari |

paragraphs.text: Whom ye with your good guidance, O Adityas, lead safely through all his pain and grief to happiness.
paragraphs.original: यमादित्यासो नयथा सुनीतिभिरति विश्वानि दुरिता स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: yamādityāso nayathā sunītibhirati viśvāni duritā svastaye

paragraphs.text: 14. That which ye guard and grace in battle, O ye Gods, ye Maruts, where the prize is wealth, where heroes win,
paragraphs.original: यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं शूरसाता मरुतो हिते धने ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ śūrasātā maruto hite dhane |

paragraphs.text: That conquering Car, O Indra, that sets forth at dawn, that never breaks, may we ascend for happiness.
paragraphs.original: प्रातर्यावाणं रथमिन्द्र सानसिमरिष्यन्तमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये
paragraphs.translit: prātaryāvāṇaṃ rathamindra sānasimariṣyantamā ruhemā svastaye

paragraphs.text: 15. Vouchsafe us blessing in our paths and desert tracts, blessing in waters and in battle, for the light;
paragraphs.original: स्वस्ति नः पथ्यासु धन्वसु स्वस्त्यप्सु वृजने स्वर्वति ।
paragraphs.translit: svasti naḥ pathyāsu dhanvasu svastyapsu vṛjane svarvati |

paragraphs.text: Blessing upon the wombs that bring male children forth, and blessing, O ye Maruts, for the gain of wealth.
paragraphs.original: स्वस्ति नः पुत्रकृथेषु योनिषु स्वस्ति राये मरुतो दधातन
paragraphs.translit: svasti naḥ putrakṛtheṣu yoniṣu svasti rāye maruto dadhātana

paragraphs.text: 16. The noblest Svasti with abundant riches, who comes to what is good by distant pathway,-
paragraphs.original: स्वस्तिरिद्धि प्रपथे श्रेष्ठा रेक्णस्वत्यभि या वाममेति ।
paragraphs.translit: svastiriddhi prapathe śreṣṭhā rekṇasvatyabhi yā vāmameti |

paragraphs.text: May she at home and far away preserve us, and dwell with us under the Gods' protection
paragraphs.original: सा नो अमा सो अरणे नि पातु स्वावेशा भवतु देवगोपा
paragraphs.translit: sā no amā so araṇe ni pātu svāveśā bhavatu devagopā

paragraphs.text: 17. Thus hath the thoughtful sage, the son of Plati, praised you, O Aditi and all Adityas,
paragraphs.original: एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी ।
paragraphs.translit: evā plateḥ sūnuravīvṛdhadvo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī |

paragraphs.text: Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.
paragraphs.original: ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन
paragraphs.translit: īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi jano divyo gayena
